about_the_game:
🖼️ Hentai Casual Swap – Exclusive Artbook

A deluxe visual treat for our most devoted fans.

Unveil the sensual secrets behind Hentai Casual Swap with this exclusive digital artbook, packed with high-resolution illustrations of your favorite waifus—now like you've never seen them before.

📚 Inside this special edition:

  • 🔓 All the uncensored artworks from the game in glorious HD

This downloadable PDF is the perfect addition for collectors, connoisseurs, and anyone who just wants more of what Hentai Casual Swap has to offer.

💡 You’ll find the artbook in the game’s installation folder, under “/ArtbookDLC” after purchase.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains stylized nudity and explicit sexual scenes in most of the artworks. All characters are adults.
